post.description: Match a known company using identifiers with the base product. Name matching is global and cannot be narrowed by country, so for non-US or ambiguous names also send the website domain as domain, or the LinkedIn company page URL as social_url.

social_url.description: Social profile URL (LinkedIn, Facebook, Crunchbase, X/Twitter, GitHub - will be normalized and detected)

industry.description: Industry filter (used with name matching for better accuracy)

min_confidence.description:
Minimum match confidence: 'high', 'moderate', or 'low'

Provider reference: allowed values ["high", "moderate", "low"].

titlecase.description:
If true, format text fields in title case (names, company names, locations). Raw fields, IDs, URLs, codes, and confidence fields are excluded.

Provider reference: default false.

required_fields.description: Comma-separated list of fields that must be present, else the match is filtered out. Supports top-level fields ('domain,socials'), a non-empty list subfield ('socials.network'), or a subfield equal to a value ('type:public', 'socials.network:linkedin'). Unknown field names or out-of-range enum values return HTTP 400.

include_fields.description: Comma-separated list of fields to include in response. If omitted, all fields are returned.

exclude_fields.description: Comma-separated list of fields to exclude from response. Applied after include_fields filter.

pretty_print.description:
If true, pretty-print JSON response with indentation.

Provider reference: default false.

post.description: Match a known person using identifiers with the base-no-contact product. Contact entitlement comes from the dedicated credential, never from field projection.

address.description: Full address string (will be parsed to extract city, state, postal_code, and country)

company.description: Company name, website, or social URL

school.description: School name, website, or social URL

birth_date.description: Birth date for matching or narrowing name-based results (YYYY-MM-DD, YYYY-MM, or YYYY). Can be used as name + birth_date lookup or as a qualifier on other name-based combos.

Provider reference: allowed values ["high", "moderate", "low"].

titlecase.description:

Provider reference: default false.

required_fields.description: Comma-separated list of fields that must be present, else the match is filtered out. Supports top-level fields ('work_email,phones'), a non-empty list subfield ('emails.type'), or a subfield equal to a value ('emails.type:personal', 'phones.type:mobile', 'socials.network:linkedin'). Unknown field names or out-of-range enum values return HTTP 400.
